summary: Decodes 8-bit palette-indexed texture data with an 8-bit alpha byte to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). Loops over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel. The first byte indexes a this-relative palette table of 4-float entries and copies the entry's four floats (RGB and an initial alpha) into the output pixel; the second byte is then scaled by 0.0039215689 (the 1/255 float folded from flt_59E460) and overwrites the output alpha channel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel (end pointer is src + 2 * this[1046]) and writing four floats per pixel.

Look up a 4-float palette entry using the first pixel byte as an index into a this-relative palette table (v7 = &this[4 * *v4 + 12]) and copy the entry's four floats to the output RGB channels and an initial alpha.
Decode the output alpha as the second pixel byte scaled by 0.0039215689, overwriting the alpha slot of the just-written output pixel.
Advance the input pointer by two bytes and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_base) where output_base is computed as the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer (a4 - 4 * this[1046]).
